title: Logic Shield
description: Team up as Zero and One to solve logic puzzles, input the password, and seal the portal before the system collapses.
about: Logic Shield is a cooperative puzzle-platformer where two players work together as Zero and One to defend the system from a digital breach. Navigate a security system, solve puzzles, and remember and input a password sequence to seal the unstable portal at the end of each level.
features: Classic couch co-op for two players, on a shared keyboard or controllers
Become the living inputs Zero and One to manipulate real logic-gate circuits
Stomp on digital foes and solve circuits in a race against the clock
10 handcrafted levels, with more to come
